note: Darkroom light rig in live-scene units (x right, y up, z toward camera). camera/diffuse/glossy/transmission are Cycles ray visibilities.

lights.name: halo
lights.note: A small soft source hidden behind the bottle, washing the plaster: the pool falls off by distance, so it has no edge, and the serum refracts it.

lights.name: kicker
lights.note: Satin highlight on the teat's dome and waist.

lights.name: edge
lights.note: A thin line of light along the plinth's front bevel.

lights.name: bounce
lights.note: A low white card lifting the plinth's front face off black.

lights.name: bulb-rim
lights.note: A thin strip that draws the teat's left edge and waist out of the dark.

lights.name: strip-body
lights.note: A tall, narrow softbox about 35 degrees camera-right: one soft vertical specular line down the body, over the print. Its face falls off across and along it (look.softbox).

lights.name: strip-edge
lights.note: A strip about 100 degrees camera-left: thin bright edge lines on the bottle and down the glass pipette. Its face falls off across and along it (look.softbox), so the line rolls off rather than clipping.

lights.name: caustic
lights.note: A hard, narrow spot behind and above the bottle (about 30 degrees up): the serum throws its tinted caustic onto the stone in front of the base.

glow.note: Physical pool: centred 0.92 up, sigma 0.38 across and 0.55 high; the card itself is transparent wherever the pool dies, so it has no edge.

print_card.note: A flagged card lighting the print alone: applied in the label layer's sleeve shader as light from this direction, falling off with the curve.

dose.note: Added for the dose only: a backlight card behind the hanging drop, seen only through the drop and pipette, and a small strip linked to the drops for one clean highlight.
